overview.description: The Polen High Income ETF (PCHI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is actively managed, consisting of high-yield, fixed income securities predominantly of middle market issuers in North America. It aims for a concentrated portfolio of 60 to 150 undervalued instruments issued by 50 to 120 issuers. PCHI was launched on Mar 25, 2025 and is issued by Polen.
